title: Li²SAO：通过组相对演员-评论家自举提升轻量单轨迹异步强化学习优化
summary: 针对SAO依赖闭源价值模型、早期训练落后于GRPO的问题，提出Li²SAO：在评论家冷启动阶段用组相对优势训练演员、组中心回报训练评论家，之后切换为单轨迹GAE，使早期训练追平或超越GRPO并提升后期性能上限。
summary_en: SAO relies on a closed-source value model and lags behind GRPO early in training. Li²SAO uses group-relative advantages to train the actor and group-centered returns to train the critic while the critic is cold, then switches to single-rollout GAE, matching or surpassing GRPO early and raising the later performance ceiling.
